test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

DISTANT
solution: The correct answer is '**Near**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym for the given blank is '**Near**'. • **Distant**: a long way away in space or time. (स्‍थान या समय की दृष्टि से काफ़ी दूर) • *Example: travel to **distant** parts of the world...* • **Near**: not far away in time or distance; close. [(समय या स्‍थान की दृष्टि से) बहुत दूर नहीं; पास, समीप, निकट] • *Example: We’re hoping to move to Wales in the **near** future [very soon].* **Correct Answer:__** *Near.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Isolated**: alone or apart from other people or things. (अन्‍य व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तुओं से अलग-थलग) • **Remote**: far away from where other people live. [(किसी स्‍थान से) बहुत दूर, दूरवर्ती] • **Removed**: take (something) away or off from the position occupied. (निकाला गया) 3e:Tb6d, The correct answer is '**Graceful**'.
